title: Costs and Getting Access
---

::: {.callout-important}
VU Amsterdam advises researchers to no longer start new projects in OSF. The project functionality will cease to work as of **19 February 2027**. Any projects expected to be active at that time will have to move to alternative tools in order to keep sharing research documents with colleagues. 

The OSF pre-registration and pre-print functionality will remain unchanged.

For further information, contact: [osfadmin@vu.nl](mailto:osfadmin@vu.nl)
:::

## How to get access?

VU Amsterdam researchers can access OSF at https://osf.io/institutions/vua. If you have a VUnetID, you can log in with your VU credentials.

### Access for students

Students are also welcome to use OSF. Note that VU students might need to visit the Service Desk to enable MFA via SURFsecureID for their student.vu.nl account if they have not done so before. The procedure is explained [in this document on the VU services portal](https://services.vu.nl/now/nav/ui/classic/params/target/kb_view.do%3Fsysparm_article%3DKB0011809). [Secure sign on - MS Authenticator activation for SURF Secure ID](https://services.vu.nl/esc?id=kb_article&table=kb_knowledge&sys_id=648865b4874bc15010be65b40cbb3592&recordUrl=%2Fkb_view.do%3Fsys_kb_id%3D648865b4874bc15010be65b40cbb3592) has more information on how to register for MFA if you have not already done so.
